verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a platform that ships a CLI, an MCP server and APIs, but the evidence pack documents no such control. The notification opt-in preferences (godaddy-docs-38) cover domain lifecycle notifications, not telemetry. The API usage-count endpoint (godaddy-docs-37) reports request volume and offers no way to opt out of tracking. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
